title: Reinstatement Rule for Expired Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Para. 1 — Who may reinstate.** An expired credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers may be reinstated where its instrument permits reinstatement and the credit's reinstatement count is below the instrument's maximum number of reinstatements.

**Para. 2 — Request window.** A reinstatement must be requested no later than the instrument's number of calendar days after the credit's expiry date as recorded on the credit. The window is counted in calendar days from the day after the expiry date, and a request on the last day of the window is accepted. The expiry date the system records for this credit is the evidence.

**Para. 3 — Restored value.** Reinstatement restores exactly the value written off at expiry, in one restore entry, and increases the reinstatement count by one. A restore entry is booked only on a credit whose status is active.

**Para. 4 — New expiry date.** The former clause that sets the new expiry date to the reinstatement date plus the instrument's reinstated validity months, with the same month-end fallback as issuance, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current basis for the reinstated term.

**Para. 5 — Fee.** The former clause under which the reinstatement fee is charged as a separate fee entry before the credit is reinstated is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current basis for the reinstatement fee. The reinstatement fee remains waived where the customer's Summit tier under the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program waives credit service fees, and a waived fee is not recorded.

**Para. 6 — Loss of value.** A credit whose instrument does not permit reinstatement, or whose window has passed, cannot be revived, and the value is lost.

## Window, day by day (hypothetical, 90-day window, expiry date 10 March 2026)

| Request date | Day of the window | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 11 March 2026 | day 1 | Within the window |
| 8 June 2026 | day 90, the last day | Accepted |
| 9 June 2026 | day 91 | Window passed; the credit cannot be revived and the value is lost |

## Restored value (hypothetical)

A credit that expired with 212.30 US dollars written off is restored with exactly 212.30 in one restore entry. Its reinstatement count rises from 0 to 1.
